alarms.action: Abort sequence to VENT, set FAIL result, illuminate ST20 fault beacon (HL-2011)
alarms.condition: Test fill pressure not reached within 8.0 s (T21 done)
alarms.name: Fill timeout

alarms.action: Latch alarm M291, close fill valve, hold vent open, set FAIL result, illuminate ST20 fault beacon (HL-2011)
alarms.condition: Pack pressure PT-2001 exceeds 20.00 kPa (D100 > D123)
alarms.name: Over-pressure

alarms.action: Activate M292, inhibit cycle start, hold unclamp in VENT, illuminate ST20 fault beacon (HL-2011)
alarms.name: PT-2001 signal fault

alarms.action: Latch alarm M293, abort sequence to VENT, set FAIL result, illuminate ST20 fault beacon (HL-2011)
alarms.condition: Supply air pressure switch PS-2009 lost (X22 OFF) while ST20 is busy (M200 ON)
alarms.name: Supply air low

conflicts.program_says: 5.0 s (R21 uses OUT T200 K50, which is 100 ms base on FX5, running for 5.0 s instead of 0.5 s; device used is T200 instead of T24)
Not directly controlled in PLC logic (mechanical regulator PR-2012)

interlocks.cause: Pallet sensor drops and returns during an active test
interlocks.effect: Must not restart sequence (prevent re-triggering while busy)

interlocks.cause: Cell not in auto mode, ST20 fault active, or station busy
Clamp confirmation lost while fill valve is open
Pack pressure not below 1.00 kPa or PT-2001 signal fault active during VENT
interlocks.effect: Station holds in VENT with vent valve held open; unclamp inhibited

interlocks.cause: E-stop chain lost (X0 OFF) while busy
interlocks.effect: Cycle aborts immediately to VENT with FAIL result
Fill valve closed, vent valve held open, cycle aborted with FAIL

interlocks.cause: Supply air low (PS-2009 lost while busy)
interlocks.effect: Cycle aborts to VENT with FAIL result

steps.entry: Pallet leaves previous cycle (ZS-2008 drops) or initialization
steps.exit: Pallet arrives at test position (ZS-2008 rising edge), cell in auto mode (X2), no ST20 fault active (M299 OFF), station idle
steps.name: IDLE / START

steps.exit: Clamp confirmed closed (ZS-2002A closed / X20 ON and ZS-2002B open / X21 OFF)
steps.name: CLAMP

steps.exit: Pack pressure PT-2001 reaches fill complete threshold (14.50 kPa / D122) or fill timeout (8.0 s / T21) aborts
steps.name: FILL

steps.entry: Fill complete reached, fill valve closed (M203 SET)
steps.name: STABILISE

steps.entry: Stabilisation timer elapses, baseline pressure recorded (M204 SET)
steps.exit: Test window timer (10.0 s / T23) elapses
steps.name: TEST

steps.entry: Test window completes (M205 SET) or abort on fault/E-stop
steps.exit: Vent timer elapses, pack pressure vented below 1.00 kPa, and PT-2001 signal healthy
steps.name: VENT

steps.exit: Clamp confirmed open (ZS-2002B made / X21 ON and ZS-2002A clear / X20 OFF)
steps.name: UNCLAMP

steps.exit: Pallet leaves test position (ZS-2008 drops / X23 OFF)
steps.name: DONE
